posts.title: Welcome to the iGEM Intelligence Machine
posts.author: The IM Team
posts.abstract: What this tool is, why we built it, and how it can save your team weeks of digging before you ever touch a bench.
posts.body:
Every year hundreds of iGEM teams reinvent the same wheels. Someone has probably already tried your chassis, your promoter, or your exact failure mode, but that knowledge is spread over a thousand wikis that go offline and change URLs.

This is a single searchable archive of every iGEM project from 2008 to 2025. Search by idea, chassis organism, molecular technique, biological part, target molecule, result, or failure.

Why it keeps working

The whole archive is built into the page, so it keeps working even if everything else goes down.
